continue.name: Continue working
continue.hint: Open your own system — a draft or an already published one.

copy.name: Make a copy
copy.hint: Take someone else's or your own as a base — the original stays untouched.

blank.name: Start from scratch
blank.hint: An empty system: take ready-made pieces or set everything up yourself.

naming.title: What shall we call the system
naming.sub: The name can be changed later — it is needed so the system can be found in the list.

list.copyHint: A copy takes everything as a whole, other people's parts too. If you only need pieces, use "Start from scratch" and "Ready-made from samples".
list.emptyHint: Start from scratch — it will appear here right after it is created.
